gloss: to give everything one has; to use up completely

definitions.gloss: to give one's all; to put out everything one has
definitions.explanation: To hold nothing back — to expend all of one's strength, skill, or ideas. Transitive, and most often used of {力|ちから} or {実力|じつりょく} in sports and work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{出|だ}し{切|き}った。
⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}し→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦{切|き}れなかった→切れる：01936_kireru⟧。
examples.english: I couldn't fully bring out the results of my practice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}し→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦{切|き}れた→切れる：01936_kireru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{負|ま}けて→負ける：01134_makeru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{悔|く}い→悔い：06648_kui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I was able to give my full ability in the final match, so I have no regrets even though I lost.

notes:
⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to put out) + ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (the compound-verb suffix meaning to do completely). The ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ ending is what supplies the sense of exhausting the supply.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{出|だ}し{切|き}る: to give all one's strength
- ⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{出|だ}し{切|き}る: to show one's full ability
- ⟦{全|すべ}て→全て：03822_subete⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{出|だ}し{切|き}る: to give absolutely everything

USAGE:
The potential negative ⟦{出|だ}し→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦{切|き}れない→切れる：01936_kireru⟧ (couldn't give it all) is very common after a disappointing performance.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{使|つか}い{切|き}る→使い切る：11518_tsukaikiru⟧: to use up — of supplies and money rather than effort
- {やり切|き}る: to see through to the end — emphasizes finishing the task, not exhausting oneself
